header:
What it costs in
**hours of work** at $20/hr

vo.text: Dinner for two? Four hours of work.
A new iPhone? Forty hours. A full week.
A year of rent? Over a thousand hours.
The average new car? Twenty-five hundred.

rungs.item: Dinner for two at a sit-down restaurant

notes: Maths: $80 ÷ $20 = 4; $799 ÷ $20 = 39.95; $20,400 ÷ $20 = 1,020; $50,000 ÷ $20 = 2,500 hours; full-time = 40 h × 52 = 2,080 h a year, so 2,500 h = 1.2 years ≈ 14.4 months. Captions off: the label stack drops into the caption band (HD Guy layout).
